Author: Limber contributors
Name: Limber
Punchline: GPose posing with drag-and-drop bone handles, bone scaling, body shaping and soft-body physics.
Description:
Pose characters by dragging handles on their bones, on top of whatever pose they already have.
- Posing: drag hands, feet, elbows, knees, head, chest and hips; pin bones in place; rotation gizmo; finger presets; undo / redo
- Attach: hold a bone on to another character (hands on shoulders, holding hands...)
- Bone scale: make any bone bigger or smaller, choosing per bone whether the bones below it grow and move with it
- Move character: move, turn and resize a whole character, on top of other plugins such as Brio
- Body physics: one click sets up soft, jiggling chest and butt from the body mod you use (IVCS / YAS skeletons; adult bodies only)
- Body shape: sliders for the body's shape, live or built into your models
- Props and colliders the body can touch and press against
- Koikatsu link: mirror Koikatsu characters' pose, face and animation live (needs the Limber Koikatsu plugin from the GitHub release)
Everything happens on your PC and your screen only. Start on the Getting started page (/limber).
